rationale_evidence.statement: DOMAIN is flagged as decision-silent: the frozen Phase-02 BC map existed through the whole discovery programme and was never consulted (occurrence #11 of proposing-before-searching); no recorded decision changed because something was classified into PD-1..PD-6, though domains did organize the discovery work itself (a scaffolding use, not a decision use). Flagged as a candidate for future simplification pressure, not a removal proposal.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Three independent proofs that D-1..D-7 do not belong in the existing schemas ... KEY COLLISION — mechanical, not aesthetic
rationale_evidence.statement: Three independent proofs that D-1..D-7 do not belong in knowledge-types.yaml or bounded-contexts.yaml: (1) key collision, mechanical and decisive — bounded-contexts.yaml already contains a 'governance' key (product-side, code_path app/Contexts/Governance), so adding D-1 'Engineering Governance' would collide with an existing key in a lint-enforced enum; (2) vocabulary insufficiency, strong — the domain model's verbs (governs, produces, consumes, validates, derives, depends on, observes) have no expression in the edge vocabulary (depends_on, derived_from, verified_by), which lacks governs/produces/consumes/observes; (3) subject mismatch, strong — every L-A field is a property of a document (knowledge_id, last_review, code_refs), but 'Engineering Method' has no reviewer, next-review date, or code refs, so it cannot carry a knowledge card. Verdict: D-1..D-7 belong to L-B (which does not yet exist); expressing them as data would require a separate vocabulary file with its own enum namespace, an ARB decision.

rationale_evidence.anchor: The chain — tested, not assumed ... DESIGN POLICY (DP-n) ... ADMIT — DISCOVERED. Neither of us named it ... ENGINEERING DOMAIN owns Capability ... REJECT as an owner
rationale_evidence.statement: Testing the reviewer's proposed chain Mission->Strategy->Principles->Capability: ENGINEERING STRATEGY is admitted (12+ charter artifacts); ENGINEERING PRINCIPLE is admitted (six registers with own identifier series: AIP-01..14, AP-1..10, PGP-01..05, MC-01..08, SD-1..7, DR-1..8); DESIGN POLICY (DP-n) is discovered as a new anchor, since the Capability Catalog binds every capability to a DP (CAP-001->DP-1, etc.) and neither the reviewer nor the author had named it; 'Engineering Domain owns Capability' is rejected — no artifact links any CAP-n to a PD-n; the reviewer's concern that capabilities must not float is correct, but the repository already anchors them to DP-n, not to a domain. Chain: MISSION -> STRATEGY -> PRINCIPLE -> DESIGN POLICY -> CAPABILITY -> KNOWLEDGE -> ARTIFACT.

rationale_evidence.anchor: THE DOMAIN ROW IS THE DISCOVERY OF THIS SECTION ... DOMAIN is a confirmed archetype with almost no outgoing edges ... ownership work is done by DP-n (governance-natured Knowledge), meaning work is done by Domains
rationale_evidence.statement: DOMAIN is confirmed as an archetype with almost no outgoing edges: it does not own capabilities (refuted), produce, constrain, or generate. What it does is scope meaning — it is the archetype of classification, not of ownership, which is orthodox strategic DDD empirically rediscovered (a subdomain never owns artifacts either; teams and contexts own things). Ownership work is done by DP-n (governance-natured Knowledge); meaning work is done by Domains. The reviewer's hierarchy places Domain as an owner in a stack; the evidence says it is a boundary-drawer standing beside the stack.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Objective 1 — Stable strategic domains? NO NEW STABLE STRATEGIC DOMAIN IS EVIDENCED
rationale_evidence.statement: Six candidate domains tested against Round47-OP's admissible-justification list: Bootstrap/Genesis fails (one criterion, n=1, not a domain); Engineering Governance already exists (a Supporting Subdomain); Knowledge Validation is not a domain but a capability family (H-CAT-1 already refused the parent abstraction); Runtime Integration is not a domain but a supporting subsystem+ACL, n=1 runtime; PKS Generation is merely an observation (n=0, never existed); Operational Learning is not a new domain but an existing mechanism governed in six places with 0 traversals. No new stable strategic domain is evidenced.

24 repository observations are recorded, each traced to a source artifact and kept strictly separate from interpretation. Key ones: O-1/O-2/O-3/O-4 (a 'Platform != product' table already classifies KnowledgeOS as potential product, Supporting Subdomain, and states the product binds the platform, never forks it); O-9 (an observed promotion model, itself a candidate for promotion); O-12 (Operational Evidence's owner recorded as 'the producing track; consumed by DA', lifecycle append-only, never edited); O-13 (a standing STOP forbidding a context map until operational evidence and an ARB ruling exist); O-16..O-18 (the Product Discovery Charter's five gated stages, PROPOSED status, one retrospective data point/zero market data points); O-20 (cross-product-research resolves to PENDING, no root); O-21 (CAP-001's Domain/Application/Shared contain zero repository knowledge); O-24 (CAP-001's evidence record holds four rows, zero tool executions, zero decisions changed).

rationale_evidence.anchor: I-1..I-12 (Interpretations — reasoning from the observations — weaker than the observations)
rationale_evidence.statement: 12 interpretations are drawn from the observations, each with a stated confidence: I-1 the strategic model the commission asks for already exists (HIGH); I-2 ES-005.3 and the commission's litmus are the same test (HIGH); I-3 AI runtimes are already modelled as adapters (HIGH); I-4 a capability-discovery lifecycle already exists, a new one would violate ES-005.4 (HIGH); I-5 operational evidence does not belong to KnowledgeOS (MEDIUM-HIGH); I-6 a context map cannot be delivered under the standing STOP (HIGH); I-7 the brainstorming documents restate charter Stage 5 while Stage 1 is unapproved (HIGH); I-8 the proposed three-way split is already structurally represented via three registered domain roots (MEDIUM-HIGH); I-9 the one genuine strain (ES-005.3's research clause) is already on the ARB's docket (MEDIUM-HIGH); I-10 the 'capability must never know repository structure' rule is already satisfied by CAP-001 (HIGH); I-11 this track is accumulating AIP-14 over-evolution exposure (MEDIUM); I-12 the extraction bar is not met (HIGH).

rationale_evidence.anchor: THE ANSWER TO "WHAT IS KNOWLEDGEOS?" ... It is not yet ONE thing. It is THREE separately-governed domains that overlap, plus a generic runtime — with NO single owner and NO reconciling authority
rationale_evidence.statement: KnowledgeOS is not one thing but three separately-governed, overlapping domains (Engineering Governance under Decision Authority, Engineering Method under sponsor+ARB, Engineering Knowledge Platform under a named individual), plus a generic runtime, with no single owner and no reconciling authority. This explains the programme's own symptoms (ten rediscoveries, two parallel ontologies, three bounded-context instruments, two decision templates, two colliding verdict vocabularies, an unfired feedback loop) as products of three unreconciled authorities over one subject, not discipline failures.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Product Relationships ... The honest state: 1 evidenced relationship, 5 candidates, 0 assigned patterns. A context map with one edge is not a failure of this discovery — it is the measurement
rationale_evidence.statement: Only one relationship is evidenced and quoted (SP-4->SP-1: 'the product binds the platform; never forks it, and the platform never absorbs product concerns', resembling Conformist plus a no-fork constraint, but not assigned per the ARB ruling). Five candidates are named but deliberately unassigned: SP-1->SP-2 (Published Language, no PKS generated); SP-2->SP-4 (Customer/Supplier, asserted never measured); SP-1<->SP-2 shared methodology (Shared Kernel, but the kernel is unbounded not shared since it sits in a product path); SP-3->SP-1 (ACL, exists in function via Capability Mapping, untested against a second runtime); SP-5->SP-1 (Customer/Supplier, zero traversals, no relationship to classify).

This label documents a long, self-critical strategic-DDD discovery effort to determine what "platform-domain" candidates exist for KnowledgeOS and whether any survive an admissible-justification bar. A final product-boundary discovery pass finds only one relationship among six candidate platform↔product edges is actually evidenced, framing the sparse context map itself as the finding, not a shortfall of the discovery [S0039].
